text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Thank you for gathering here today, everyoneâª

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we get started right away—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Where fierce warriors—Princesses—dance and battle—
A magnificent Grand Ball of War!!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even if it's against you, Senpai, I won't give up first place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Being a princess really isn't my thing, but...
when it comes to running, I won't lose...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
An invitation that isn't official duty is wonderful!
I'm going to take lots and lots of photos♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone,
the first dance will begin in 10 minutes.
Please get ready!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was supposed to be the day Kawakami Princess
hosted her "martial ball," or so I heard, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please listen, Trainer!
I was thinking of hosting a "dance battle" next time♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The "Bout-Ball" where PriFai took part as a princess!
I'm getting so hyped up just thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely become the most radiant
princess at the Grand Ball~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, they seemed far too fired up for an 'elegant dance party.'
Curious, I went to check on the situation—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, Trainer, you came!
I was just about to start running!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely! Giving it your all to compete
and determine victory or defeat—that is what a "Bout-oukai" is all about!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am so glad you could come~!
Actually, the Prince of PriFie—in other words,
the "Legendary Trainer"—is also...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I supported the princess heading into the "Dance Brawl" by her side!
Just like you support me right now, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With your cheers and the power of this dress,
Trainer, I am truly invincible today!!
choice_data_list: Your racing outfit is a dress?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's right! Formal wear for a warrior princess—in other words, a dress!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "I poured all of my ideals to the brim into this racing outfit!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A powerful pink, blending the flames of fighting spirit
with a sparkle of pure innocence—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pouring an unyielding, unbreakable will
into this diamond motif!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I had the dress designed not for who I am now, but for who I aspire to be, because I want to become someone worthy of it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"To shine brighter than anyone and stand stronger than anyone,
a princess must possess the resolve to never give up!"
choice_data_list: That dress looks great on you.
Let's show them how a princess runs!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I think so myself♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: After all, this dress was tailored to suit me better today than yesterday, and even more so tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please watch me, Trainer!
I shall run a race worthy of this dress!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now then, everyone, if you would, please!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, let's make some wonderful memories♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here I comeâ!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Nwooooooohh!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kh...! So fast...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I...!!! In this racing dress,
shall shine more like a princess than anyone else~!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Alllriiiight! Regal and proud!
I went all out and blew them away, darlinggg!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Argh, so frustrating! Kawakami-san, please give me
a rematch—I'm definitely taking first place next time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
As a princess, I shall accept the challenge anytime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved a magnificent victory,
Kawakami Princess was sparkling brightly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Naturally!
I shall blow them completely away!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now then, everyone, if you would, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Running with everything I have, that's all there is to it...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Here I comeâ!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm... number oneee!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wah! Everyone's so fast—but still!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Guh…… gnuuuaaaargh~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Just! A little! Moreeee, darn itttt~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Guuuugh, it's so frustratinggg!! For a princess like me to suffer defeat...!
choice_data_list: You're a princess— don't give up, on to the next!
If you're a princess, don't give up— on to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, y-you are quite right.
As a princess, I would become a laughingstock if I faltered here!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Besides, I have my Trainer by my side... With pure grit and endless practice—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: At the next dance battle, I shall be the star of the show~~!
